newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Alenia seen with stake in Airbus.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Alenia seen with stake in Airbus.

text.p: Italian manufacturer Alenia will receive a stake in European plane-making consortium Airbus Industrie in exchange for assets, the managing director of parent company Finmeccanica, Bruno Steve, said on Tuesday.

He told reporters at an Italian business seminar that Alenia expected to take a 10 percent stake in the Airbus A3XX project to build a 555-seat super jumbo and a 15 percent stake in a project for a new 100-seater aircraft.

"We will join Airbus with the value of our assets and we will obtain shares in the company. We will certainly have positions on the board," Steve said. "The intention is to see all our efforts in Airbus recognised," he added.
The existing Airbus consortium partners are Aerospatiale of France, Daimler-Benz of Germany, British Aerospace Plc and Construcciones Aeronauticas SA of Spain.
Steve did not say how large Alenia's stake in the consortium would be.
The partners reached an agreement with Alenia last December that envisages further rationalisation of the aeronautical industry and Alenia's future entry into the consortium.

The agreement envisages Alenia and Airbus Industrie forming a new company together for the 100-seater project to manage European participation in a joint venture with China and Singapore. --Rome newsroom +39 6 6782505
